May and June expert consultation schedule

Hanno Chamber of Commerce and Industry will hold expert consultations on the following dates. Available to chamber members only.

【May consultation schedule】
May 8 (Friday) 10:00 – Personnel and labor consultation (Instructor Yuki Yokoji)
May 13 (Wednesday) 13:30 – Business succession and M&A consultation (Business succession specialists and various licensed professionals)
May 14 (Thursday) 9:30 – Free individual tax and invoice system consultation (Tax accountants from the Hanno district of the Kanto-Shinetsu Tax Accountants Association Tokorozawa branch)
May 15 (Friday) 13:30 – Consultation with Japan Finance Corporation (Kawagoe branch)
May 18 (Monday) 10:00 – Intellectual property consultation (Instructor Katsuji Matsuda)
May 19 (Tuesday) 13:30 – Business law consultation (Instructor Sho Sasaki)

【June consultation schedule】
June 10 (Wednesday) 13:30 – Business succession and M&A consultation
June 12 (Friday) 10:00 – Personnel and labor consultation
June 15 (Monday) 10:00 – Intellectual property consultation and consultation with Japan Finance Corporation
June 16 (Tuesday) 13:30 – Business law consultation

【Reservations】
Proceed with your reservation through the booking link for each consultation. For tax consultations, the reservation deadline is 5 business days before the consultation date by mid-morning.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2613/
